_note: SEED dataset: small, hand-written, synthetic documents and relevance labels (3=best, 1=related). It exists to exercise the evaluation harness and catch regressions. It is NOT a measure of real-world quality: replace/extend it with real queries, real crawled pages and labels from native Afaan Oromoo speakers before trusting any number or tuning any weight on it.

docs.body: Barattoonni yunivarsiitii Oromiyaa keessa baratan kitaaba fi laayibreerii fayyadamu. Barattoonni baay'een leenjii hojii argatu.

docs.title: Mana barumsaa fi barsiistota
docs.body: Manni barumsaa ijoollee barsiisa. Barsiistoonni mana barumsaa keessatti ni hojjatu. Mana barumsaa Oromiyaa keessa hedduu ijaaramaniiru.

docs.title: Seenaa Oromoo
docs.body: Oromoon uummata guddaa Itiyoophiyaa keessa jiru dha. Afaan isaanii Afaan Oromoo jedhama. Seenaan Oromoo jaarraa hedduu dura eegala.

docs.title: Oomisha bunaa Oromiyaa
docs.body: Oromiyaa keessatti qonnaan bultoonni bunaa oomisu. Oomishni bunaa Oromiyaa addunyaa keessatti beekama.

docs.title: Nyaata fayyaa eegsisu
docs.body: Nyaata gaarii nyaachuun fayyaa nama eegsisa. Muduraa fi kuduraa guyyaa guyyaan nyaachuun gaarii dha.

docs.title: Afaan Oromoo fi barreeffama Qubee
docs.body: Afaan Oromoo qubee Laatiinii fayyadama. Qubeen Afaan Oromoo qubee Laatiinii irratti hundaa'a.

docs.title: Magaalaa Finfinnee
docs.body: Finfinneen magaalaa guddoo Oromiyaa fi Itiyoophiyaa dha. Namoonni hedduun Finfinnee keessa jiraatu.
